name: chronometric-age
title: Chronometric Age
description: The age of a specimen or related materials that is generated from a dating assay.
comments: To represent a single age, enter the same value in both earliestChronometricAge and latestChronometricAge. Leaving one or both of these fields blank indicates that the value is unknown, has yet to be recorded or is not applicable to the material being described. We recommend that you do not use this class to indicate chronostratigraphy: it is intended to be used to reflect a chronometric age or range of ages determined via one or more named analytical protocols, methods or techniques.
rdfs:comment: The age of a specimen or related materials that is generated from a dating assay.

fields.name: chronometricAge_pk
fields.title: Chronometric Age (Primary Key)
fields.description: A unique identifier for an ltc:ChronometricAge.
fields.comments: The value in this field MAY be changed in aggregation to guarantee uniqueness.
fields.rdfs:comment: A unique identifier for an ltc:ChronometricAge.

fields.name: objectGroup_fk
fields.title: Object Group (Foreign Key)
fields.comments: The value in this field MAY be changed in aggregation to preserve the relationship to the (Primary Key).
fields.rdfs:comment: This property refers to one or more related instances of the ChronometricAge class.

fields.name: chronometricAgeProtocol
fields.title: Chronometric Age Protocol
fields.description: A description of or reference to the methods used to determine the chronometric age.
fields.examples: `Radiocarbon dating using an Accelerator Mass Spectrometry`, `Pb-Pb Dating`, `41Ca - 41K Chronometer`, `U-Pb Dating using a Thermal Ionization Mass Spectrometer`, `U-Pb Radiometric Dating`, `Thermoluminescence`, `Paleomagnetism`, `Pb-Pb Chronometer as described in Amelin et al. (2002) Science 297, 1678-1683`
fields.rdfs:comment: A description of or reference to the methods used to determine the chrono:ChronometricAge.

fields.name: chronometricAgeRemarks
fields.title: Chronometric Age Remarks
fields.description: Notes or comments about the ChronometricAge.
fields.examples: `Beta Analytic number: 323913` `One of the Crassostrea virginica right valve specimens from North Midden Feature 17 was chosen for AMS dating, but it is unclear exactly which specimen it was.`
fields.rdfs:comment: Notes or comments about the chrono:ChronometricAge.

fields.name: chronometricAgeUncertaintyInYears
fields.title: Chronometric Age Uncertainty In Years
fields.description: The temporal uncertainty of the earliestChronometricAge and latestChronometicAge in years.
fields.comments: The expected unit for this field is years. The value in this field is number of years before and after the values given in the earliest and latest chronometric age fields within which the actual values are estimated to be.
fields.rdfs:comment: The temporal uncertainty of the chrono:earliestChronometricAge and chrono:latestChronometricAge in years.

fields.name: earliestChronometricAge
fields.title: Earliest Chronometric Age
fields.description: The maximum/earliest/oldest possible age of a specimen as determined by a dating method.
fields.comments: The expected unit for this field is years. This field, if populated, must have an associated earliestChronometricAgeReferenceSystem.
fields.rdfs:comment: The maximum/earliest/oldest possible age of a specimen as determined by a dating method.

fields.name: earliestChronometricAgeReferenceSystem
fields.title: Earliest Chronometric Age Reference System
fields.description: The reference system associated with the earliestChronometricAge.
fields.rdfs:comment: The reference system associated with the chrono:earliestChronometricAge.

fields.name: latestChronometricAge
fields.title: Latest Chronometric Age
fields.description: The minimum/latest/youngest possible age of a specimen as determined by a dating method.
fields.comments: The minimum/latest/youngest possible age of an object in the collection as determined by a dating method. The expected unit for this field is years. This field, if populated, must have an associated latestChronometricAgeReferenceSystem.
fields.rdfs:comment: The minimum/latest/youngest possible age of a specimen as determined by a dating method.

fields.name: latestChronometricAgeReferenceSystem
fields.title: Latest Chronometric Age Reference System
fields.description: The reference system associated with the latestChronometricAge.
fields.comments: Recommended best practice is to use a controlled vocabulary.
fields.rdfs:comment: The reference system associated with the chrono:latestChronometricAge.

fields.name: verbatimChronometricAge
fields.title: Verbatim Chronometric Age
fields.description: The verbatim age for a specimen, whether reported by a dating assay, associated references, or legacy information.
fields.comments: The verbatim age for the objects in the collection, whether reported by a dating assay, associated references, or legacy information. For example, this could be the radiocarbon age as given in an AMS dating report. This could also be simply what is reported as the age of a specimen in legacy collections data.
fields.rdfs:comment: The verbatim age for a specimen, whether reported by a dating assay, associated references, or legacy information.
